scope: All one-bit insertions/deletions and nonzero cyclic rotations of the 319 pinned published witnesses, comparing only the 95 audited open frontier lengths; keep two non-published symmetry orbits per target length.
selection: Select at most 16 distinct lengths, ranked by lowest transformed E / published E. Choose the best new orbit per length. Do not count inherited published ties.
classification: Exploratory structured search, separate from the frozen held-out algorithm comparison. All unsuccessful transformations remain in the aggregate denominator and group logs.
